blocks.text: Jaisa pichhle paragraph mein bataya, janeen (foetus) ki zyada tar cartilage haddi mein badal jati hai. Lekin kuch cartilage saari zindagi baqi rehti hai aur lachak (flexibility) deti hai, maslan haddiyon ke beech, naak ke sire par, bahar ke kaan mein aur trachea (saans ki nali) ke andar.

Cartilage ke gird connective tissue ki ek tah hoti hai jise perichondrium kehte hain. Is mein khoon ki naliyan, lymph ki naliyan aur nerves hoti hain jo cartilage ko ghiza aur signals pohanchati hain. Perichondrium ke andar cartilage matrix hai jo collagen, elastin, proteoglycans aur doosre fibres se bana hai. Yeh cartilage ko mazbooti, lachak aur dabne se bachne ki taqat deta hai. Doosre connective tissues ke ulat cartilage matrix ke andar khoon ki naliyan nahin hotin. Cartilage ke cells ko ghiza diffusion (phail kar pohanchne) se milti hai. Isi wajah se cartilage bohat aahista theek hoti hai.

Cartilage ke cells chondrocytes kehlate hain. Yeh chhoti khali jagahon, lacunae, mein hote hain jo cartilage matrix mein dhansi hoti hain. Chondrocytes cartilage ka matrix banate aur qaim rakhte hain (Fig. 12.4).

Cartilage teen qism ki hoti hai. Hyaline cartilage sab se aam hai; yeh naak, trachea aur joron mein haddiyon ki milne wali satah par hoti hai. Fibrocartilage jism ki un jagahon par hoti hai jahan bohat dabao aur khinchao (stress aur tension) hota hai, maslan intervertebral discs (vertebrae ke beech ki gaddiyan) aur pubic symphysis. Elastic cartilage bahar ke kaan aur epiglottis mein hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Cartilage ke teen blocks, har ek ke upar gulabi perichondrium ki tah: hyaline cartilage jis mein lacunae ke andar chondrocytes kam reshon wali sada matrix mein phaile hain; fibrocartilage jis mein ghane mutawazi collagen reshon ke beech kam chondrocytes hain; elastic cartilage jis mein bikhre chhote reshon ke beech bohat se chondrocytes hain. blocks.text: Teenon mein woh hi cheezein hain: upar perichondrium, andar matrix, aur lacunae mein chondrocytes. Farq reshon mein hai: hyaline mein reshe kam aur matrix sheeshe jaisi, fibrocartilage mein ghane collagen reshe (mazbooti, jaise discs mein), elastic mein elastic reshe (lachak, jaise kaan ki lau mein).
